user.title: Set up Gaian Grid Telemetry
user.description: Enter your Gaian Grid enrollment token and choose any electricity sensors you have. Not all fields are required. Whole-grid voltage, frequency, and power are preferred when available, but even a single voltage sensor still helps.

data_description.grid_voltage_entity_ids: Preferred if available. Choose one or more sensors measuring whole-grid voltage in V. If you only have voltage from smart plugs, that still helps.
data_description.grid_frequency_entity_ids: Preferred if available. Choose one or more sensors measuring whole-grid frequency in Hz.
data_description.grid_net_power_entity_ids: Use this if you have a single whole-grid power sensor in W where import is positive and export is negative. Do not also fill in Grid import power or Grid export power.
data_description.grid_import_power_entity_ids: Use this if you have one or more separate whole-grid import sensors in W.
data_description.grid_export_power_entity_ids: Use this if you have one or more separate whole-grid export sensors in W.
data_description.additional_power_entity_ids: Optional. Use for other useful electricity power sensors in W, such as inverter power, battery power, or circuit loads. These are not added into whole-grid totals.
data_description.reactive_power_entity_ids: Optional. Choose one or more sensors measuring reactive power in var.
data_description.telemetry_interval_seconds: Advanced. Used as the local publish interval until Gaian Grid sends managed settings.
data_description.heartbeat_interval_seconds: Advanced. Used as the local heartbeat interval until Gaian Grid sends managed settings.

reauth.title: Refresh Gaian Grid credentials
reauth.description: Enter a fresh enrollment token to rotate the broker credentials for this Gaian Grid site.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Gaian Grid telemetry
reconfigure.description: Update the local sensor selection and fallback intervals. Whole-grid voltage, frequency, and power are preferred when available, but even a single voltage sensor still helps.

error.cannot_connect: Enrollment succeeded, but Home Assistant could not connect to the MQTT broker returned by the hub.
error.cannot_reach_hub: Could not reach Gaian Grid. Check public reachability to https://gaiangrid.com and the deployed service health.
error.sensor_selection_required: Select at least one supported electricity sensor.
error.duplicate_sensor_selection: Each sensor can only be selected once.
error.conflicting_grid_power_selection: Choose either whole-grid net power sensors or separate whole-grid import/export sensors, not both.
error.hub_rejected_enrollment: The hub rejected the enrollment request.
error.hub_request_failed: The hub request failed before enrollment could complete.
error.hub_timeout: Timed out waiting for the hub to respond.
error.invalid_enrollment_response: The hub returned an invalid enrollment response.
error.invalid_enrollment_token: The enrollment token is invalid, expired, revoked, or already used.
error.invalid_hub_url: The configured Gaian Grid URL is invalid.
error.unsupported_voltage_selection: Grid voltage sensors must use V.
error.unsupported_frequency_selection: Grid frequency sensors must use Hz.
error.unsupported_power_selection: Whole-grid and additional power sensors must use W.
error.unsupported_reactive_power_selection: Reactive power sensors must use var.
error.unsupported_mqtt_transport: The hub returned an unsupported MQTT transport. This integration supports MQTT over TLS on TCP only.

abort.already_configured: This site ID is already configured.
